parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 reduced val_bpb from 1.098676 to 1.064299. The extra capacity seems to benefit from the current LR/warmup setup. I'll continue pushing model capacity. Next: exploring higher DEPTH or optimizing the ASPECT_RATIO/LR balance.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 to maximize model capacity within the 5-minute budget, while slightly lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to compensate for the increased parameter count and ensure stability.
